verses.1: All that I command you to do, you must keep. Do not fail to carry out these commands, and do not omit any of them.
verses.2: For perhaps a prophet or a dreamer will rise up before you, and he will give you some warning.
verses.3: And there came the fear and dread of what was spoken to you: “We will go after other gods, who you do not know. We will worship them instead.”
verses.4: Do not listen to the words of that prophet, nor to his dreams. For Jehovah your God will test you to see whether you truly love Him with all your heart and soul.
verses.5: After Jehovah, your God, you shall go. You shall fear Him and keep His commandments. You shall listen to His voice and serve Him, and in Him you shall find your hope.
verses.6: And that prophet, or that dreamer, will die because he spoke evil against Jehovah your God, who brought you out of Egypt from the land of slavery. He also tried to lead you away from the path that Jehovah your God commanded you to follow.
verses.7: For your brothers, your son, your daughter, or your wife, who are your relatives, may say, “Let us go and worship other gods, whom you and your ancestors did not know.”
verses.8: Of the gods of those nations who are around you, those who come close to you or those who are far away from you, from one end of the earth to the other.
verses.9: Do not desire him, do not listen to him, do not judge him with your eyes, and do not be afraid of him.
verses.10: For if you kill him, your hand will be in his place as a murderer. And the hands of all the people will be in their places as murderers as well.
verses.11: And he was buried in stones, and he died. For he tried to put you above Jehovah your God, who brought you out of Egypt from the house of slavery.
verses.12: And all of Israel will hear and fear, and they will not do this evil thing in your presence.
verses.13: For when you hear of one of your cities being given to you by the LORD your God, so that you may settle there, as it is said.
verses.14: Men from Bethel came from your place, and they sent away the rulers of their city, saying, “Let us go and worship other gods, whom we do not know.”
verses.15: And you have studied and examined it carefully. You have asked the right questions, and now you see that the truth is indeed true. This suffering has taken place in your midst.
verses.16: You shall destroy the inhabitants of that city according to the judgment. You shall also destroy everything that is in it, and its animals as well, according to the judgment.
verses.17: And all her treasures shall be destroyed within its walls. You shall burn the city and all its treasures with fire, as it is written by your God, Jehovah. It shall become a forever-ruined city, and no one will ever build it again.
verses.18: And do not take revenge against those who have sinned against you, so that the LORD may be gracious to you and have mercy on you, as He has shown kindness to your ancestors.
verses.19: For when you hear the voice of the LORD your God, you will keep all His commands that I command you today to do. In order to do what is right in the eyes of the LORD your God.
